label: First copy output step after <DEL> in length-3 sequences (recall of token 1)
explanation: Dominant component: in L=3 sequences, at the step right after <DEL> (t=4, input = original token 0, outputting original token 1). This is ~99% precise and holds ~70% of activation mass; the top activations (up to 0.094) are all here, with input-token modulation (h, e, c, b, f strongest). A weaker continuation fires at the last L=3 copy step (t=5, ~6% mass). Separately, many small activations (about 61% of active steps but only ~21% of mass, typically <0.1 of max) occur at t=1 in the original phase in sequences of any length, more often for in_tok h/b/c/f/z/0/1 and prev_tok a/p/s/r/f; these are not captured by the predicate. It never fires at t=0, at the <DEL> step, or at any step t>=6, and essentially never in copy phase for L>=4.
